correctness.rationale: Exact enumeration of all 4096 subsets gives 323 nonempty simplices; the patchwork matching has 149 pairs and critical-cell vector (1,0,2,22). The full 972-incidence reversed Hasse diagram passes an exhaustive topological sort. Signed integer Morse cancellation has two critical degree-two rows and a determinant-one two-column minor, so after Hurewicz-based CW cancellation the homotopy type is a wedge of 20 three-spheres; finite-field checks corroborate but do not substitute for integral proof. Two explicit edge-preserving generators yield all 120 graph automorphisms; signed simplex Lefschetz traces are class functions, their A5 character decomposition is integral and the rational quotient invariant has rank one. All computations are reproduced from a standalone package script.

value.rationale: The icosahedron is a canonical highly symmetric Platonic graph, and the 2-independence/dissociation complex is its natural first higher-independence object. The exact integral 20-sphere homotopy classification and complete 120-automorphism rational module reveal a 15/5 central eigenspace split and a nonzero invariant class on the symmetry quotient. These precise structure results are not implied by existing general definitions, previously classified graph families or the ordinary icosahedral independence/neighborhood/matching complexes.
